patch_description: Replace the single Dijkstra path per destination with a bounded k-shortest-path search (k=4) using `islice` over `nx.shortest_simple_paths` with weight="cost". For each destination, evaluate up to 4 simple paths and pick the cheapest one. This can find cheaper routes than single-source Dijkstra when the Dijkstra-optimal path to one destination conflicts with shared trunk usage for others. Using `islice` (never `list(...)`) bounds memory/time; fall back to plain Dijkstra if the generator fails (e.g., disconnected pairs), preserving the 100% success rate.
